source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 1 Grammar in Use:-ing/-ed forms used as complements。句子地道、答案唯一(由宾语与分词的主被动关系判定)。

points.point: -ing 作补语(感官/使役 + 现在分词:主动、正在进行)
points.overview: see/hear/watch/notice/feel/find/keep/leave + sb/sth + 现在分词(doing):宾语主动发出动作、动作正在进行时,补语用 -ing 形式。

points.point: -ed 作补语(have/get/make/find/keep sth + 过去分词:被动、已完成)
points.overview: have/get/make/find/keep/leave/want + sth + 过去分词(done):宾语承受动作、动作已完成或被动,补语用 -ed 形式,如 have my hair cut。

points.point: -ing vs -ed 补语辨析(由宾语与分词的主被动关系判定)
points.overview: 宾语主动发出动作、动作进行中 → 用 -ing(I saw him crossing);宾语承受动作、动作被动/已完成 → 用 -ed(I saw the work done)。看宾语和分词谁主动谁被动来选。

questions.stem: During the interview, the comic star could feel his heart ____ fast.
questions.explanation: his heart 主动跳动、动作正在进行 → 现在分词 beating。

questions.stem: After midnight, the professor was seen ____ an experiment in the lab.
questions.explanation: 宾语(被见者)主动做实验、动作进行中 → doing。

questions.stem: It was friendship that kept me ____ during my hardest time.
questions.explanation: keep sb doing:me 主动'坚持下去'、动作持续 → going。

questions.stem: The teacher found the child ____ on the wall with a piece of chalk.
questions.explanation: the child 主动在写、动作进行中 → writing。

questions.stem: We heard Tu Youyou ____ about her years of hard research.
questions.explanation: hear sb doing:她主动讲述、动作进行中 → talking。

questions.stem: The lecturer was heard ____ his success story in the next room.
questions.explanation: 被听者主动讲述、动作进行中 → telling。

questions.stem: From the window I watched the runners ____ slowly up the long hill.
questions.explanation: watch sb doing:runners 主动爬坡、动作进行中 → climbing。

questions.stem: Don't leave the tap ____ while you brush your teeth.
questions.explanation: leave sth doing:the tap 主动'流'、状态持续 → running。

questions.stem: She noticed her young students ____ harder than ever before the exam.
questions.explanation: notice sb doing:students 主动学习、进行中 → working。

questions.stem: The coach kept the whole team ____ even when they wanted to quit.
questions.explanation: keep sb doing:team 主动坚持尝试 → trying。

questions.stem: Late at night, neighbours could hear the young pianist ____ the same piece.
questions.explanation: hear sb doing:pianist 主动练习、进行中 → practising。

questions.stem: I caught my little brother ____ at my secret notebook again.
questions.explanation: catch sb doing:brother 主动偷看、进行中 → looking。

questions.stem: On the screen we saw the scientist ____ the plant for a cure.
questions.explanation: see sb doing:scientist 主动测试、进行中 → testing。

questions.stem: The doctor felt the patient's hand ____ as the good news arrived.
questions.explanation: feel sth doing:hand 主动颤抖、进行中 → shaking。

questions.stem: During the speech, I could see many graduates ____ with hope.
questions.explanation: see sb doing:graduates 主动微笑、进行中 → smiling。

questions.stem: We left the lights ____ so that the late workers could find their way.
questions.explanation: leave sth doing:lights 主动'亮着'、状态持续 → shining。

questions.stem: Through the door, she watched her father ____ over his old medical books.
questions.explanation: watch sb doing:father 主动俯身、进行中 → bending。

questions.stem: Suddenly we heard the crowd ____ the marathon runner's name.
questions.explanation: hear sb doing:crowd 主动呼喊、进行中 → shouting。

questions.stem: He found his old teacher still ____ in the same quiet office.
questions.explanation: find sb doing:teacher 主动工作、进行中 → working。

questions.stem: The nurse kept the medicine ____ slowly into the patient's arm.
questions.explanation: keep sth doing:medicine 主动'流'、动作持续 → flowing。

questions.stem: The writer wants his new novel ____ at the book fair next week.
questions.explanation: want sth done:novel 被展示、动作被动 → displayed。

questions.stem: Before the big speech, he went to have his hair ____ short.
questions.explanation: have sth done:hair 被剪 → 过去分词 cut。

questions.stem: After much persistence, the team finally got the problem ____.
questions.explanation: get sth done:problem 被解决、已完成 → solved。

questions.stem: All afternoon she worked in the study with the door ____.
questions.explanation: with the door done:door 被锁 → locked。

questions.stem: Tammy was disappointed to find her suggestions ____ down.
questions.explanation: find sth done:suggestions 被否决 → turned(down)。

questions.stem: Tu Youyou wanted the old prescriptions ____ into a single collection.
questions.explanation: want sth done:prescriptions 被收集 → gathered。

questions.stem: She finally had the new treatment ____ as safe for humans.
questions.explanation: have sth done:treatment 被证明、已完成 → proved。

questions.stem: He kept his eyes ____ during the last few minutes of the surgery.
questions.explanation: keep sth done:eyes 被闭上、状态已成 → closed。

questions.stem: The young poet managed to get a collection of her poems ____.
questions.explanation: get sth done:poems 被出版 → published。

questions.stem: With her talent ____ by more and more people, she became famous.
questions.explanation: with sth done:talent 被认可 → recognised。

questions.stem: Make yourself ____ — speak slowly and clearly to the audience.
questions.explanation: make oneself done:被理解 → understood(make oneself understood 固定)。

questions.stem: She left most of the work ____ until the results were conclusive.
questions.explanation: leave sth done:work 被'未完成'状态 → unfinished(过去分词作补语)。

questions.stem: The committee wants the meeting room ____ before the guests arrive.
questions.explanation: want sth done:room 被布置好 → prepared。

questions.stem: He was brave enough to have the test ____ on himself first.
questions.explanation: have sth done:test 被进行 → run(过去分词)。

questions.stem: After the long debate, she finally made her point ____ to everyone.
questions.explanation: make sth done:point 被说清楚 → shown。

questions.stem: With the experiment ____ at last, the whole team cheered.
questions.explanation: with sth done:experiment 被完成 → completed。

questions.stem: She got the ancient book ____ word by word to find the answer.
questions.explanation: get sth done:book 被审查 → examined。

questions.stem: The artist wanted his shrimps ____ in shades of black ink.
questions.explanation: want sth done:shrimps 被画 → painted。

questions.stem: He kept his goal clearly ____ in his mind for many years.
questions.explanation: keep sth done:goal 被固定/记牢 → fixed。

questions.stem: Don't leave your dream ____ — work hard to make it real.
questions.explanation: leave sth done:dream 被遗忘 → forgotten。

questions.stem: I saw the young researcher ____ tests on the plant all night long.
questions.explanation: 宾语 researcher 主动做测试、进行中 → 现在分词 running。

questions.stem: She had the final results ____ before she dared to announce them.
questions.explanation: 宾语 results 被核对、动作被动 → 过去分词 checked。

questions.stem: We watched the old painter ____ a shrimp with a few quick strokes.
questions.explanation: 宾语 painter 主动作画、进行中 → drawing。

questions.stem: He finally got his speech ____ in time for the graduation.
questions.explanation: 宾语 speech 被写出、被动完成 → written。

questions.stem: Through the door we could hear someone ____ the same word again and again.
questions.explanation: 宾语 someone 主动重复、进行中 → repeating。

questions.stem: She kept the difficult question ____ until she found a better answer.
questions.explanation: 宾语 question 被'未作答'、被动 → 过去分词 unanswered。

questions.stem: From the stage, I noticed my parents ____ at me with pride.
questions.explanation: 宾语 parents 主动微笑、进行中 → smiling。

questions.stem: He wanted the whole report ____ before the meeting started.
questions.explanation: 宾语 report 被完成、被动 → finished。

questions.stem: I could feel the cold wind ____ against my face as I ran.
questions.explanation: 宾语 wind 主动吹、进行中 → blowing。

questions.stem: She had her old photos ____ and put them in a new album.
questions.explanation: 宾语 photos 被打印、被动 → printed。

questions.stem: We saw the marathon runner ____ towards the finish line at last.
questions.explanation: 宾语 runner 主动冲刺、进行中 → rushing。

questions.stem: He kept the office door ____ so that no one would disturb him.
questions.explanation: 宾语 door 被关、被动状态 → 过去分词 shut。

questions.stem: At dawn I found my grandfather already ____ in the garden.
questions.explanation: 宾语 grandfather 主动劳作、进行中 → working。

questions.stem: She wanted the difficult words ____ on the board for everyone to see.
questions.explanation: 宾语 words 被写、被动 → written。

questions.stem: We could hear the rain ____ heavily on the roof all night.
questions.explanation: 宾语 rain 主动落下、进行中 → falling。

questions.stem: He had the broken microphone ____ just before his thank-you speech.
questions.explanation: 宾语 microphone 被修好、被动 → fixed。

questions.stem: I watched the little boy ____ on the wall with a piece of chalk.
questions.explanation: 宾语 boy 主动画、进行中 → drawing。

questions.stem: She got her main points ____ on cue cards before the talk.
questions.explanation: 宾语 points 被记下、被动 → noted。

questions.stem: Late at night, he could hear his own heart still ____ with excitement.
questions.explanation: 宾语 heart 主动跳动、进行中 → beating。

questions.stem: After years of effort, she finally saw her dream ____ true.
questions.explanation: see sth come true 为感官动词后接动词原形的固定用法,强调'梦想实现'这一完整过程 → come。
